comment: The pole mix knobs are configured here with a range of -32 to +32, while the Bascom parameters they write into are clamped to -18 to +18, so the ends of these knobs do nothing. No range is quoted in the lines for that reason. The expander reads module->leftExpander and does nothing unless the module there is a Bascom, so it goes to the right of the filter. It ships nineteen presets of its own for the lowpass, highpass, bandpass, notch, all pass and phaser modes at 6, 12, 18 and 24dB.
